tasks.gr8-revision-oral-completion-t4: Topic: Revision and oral completion. Cover portfolio completion, mixed-genre revision, oral reflection, and exam preparation strategies. Ask Grade 8 learners to apply skimming and scanning, answer integrated revision questions, organise oral responses, and select effective revision habits for year-end assessment.
tasks.gr8-examination-writing-t4: Topic: Examination writing. Cover essay and transactional writing under timed conditions, planning quickly, format recall, register control, editing under pressure, and time management. Ask Grade 8 learners to choose suitable text forms, organise responses efficiently, and identify high-impact final checks before submission.
tasks.gr8-language-literature-consolidation-t4: Topic: Language and literature consolidation. Cover comprehension, literature response, grammar revision, and summary writing in integrated paper-style practice. Ask Grade 8 learners to retrieve evidence, interpret literary ideas, produce concise summaries, and apply accurate language structures across mixed tasks.
tasks.gr8-newspaper-magazine-article-t4: Topic: Writing a Newspaper or Magazine Article. Cover the headline, by-line, lead (who, what, where, when, why), body in order of importance, quotations, fact and opinion, and the past tense. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify a part, tell fact from opinion or choose a good lead.
tasks.gr8-diary-entry-t4: Topic: Writing a Diary Entry. Cover the date, first person, events in order, feelings, informal but correct language, exact feeling words and reflection. Ask Grade 8 learners to spot the correct features or the stronger sentence.
tasks.gr8-journalistic-report-t4: Topic: Writing a Journalistic (News) Report. Cover objective tone, the headline and lead, facts first, named sources, fairness to both sides, the past tense, and how a news report differs from an article. Ask Grade 8 learners to tell an objective sentence from an opinion or say why sources are named.
